items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: Dagnacca came along and played clarinet... Then, he come along with a job playing supraina saxophone and clarinet... Dan got his saxophone... I said, Dan, you got your supraina hole? Yeah. I said, let me have it... I go, go to the malls, I buy a C melody saxophone... I start playing the C melody.

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh, I didn't know that. When they went to the place, there were two trumpets, and they had a piano, but most of the places never had piano in the day. Oh, I know. Very few played. But, where we went, you know what I mean? So, I'm going to tell you what happened now. When saxophone's voice got popular, this is this. You know, we didn't have no saxophone players here around 1920, 1920, 1920, 1920, and there was no saxophone. There was only one saxophone player, two saxophone players in the city of New…
Did you have a banjo and chilling?
